liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Big Railroad Blues** (1 review): Jerry's riffs on Big Railroad Blues are highlighted [24]
- **Let it Grow** (1 review): Rare set II Let It Grow is a top 80s performance [24]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): He's Gone is really wonderful [19]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Bobby sings alternate lyrics about Sweet Jane's sex change in Truckin' [27]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-07-28.sbd.browning-feinberg.32707.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 25 songs; 164 min; rated 3.15/5 by 13 [1]. Said about its sound: Rain storm caused sound problems, with guitars dropping in and out; Light static appears in the right channel at a few spots [1]
- **gd82-07-28.fob-senn421.wise.4980.sbefail.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 163 min; rated 4.28/5 by 29 [2]. Said about its sound: Bob and Brent's piano created a jangly sound throughout the performance; The crowd tape is very good, slightly less than the previous day's; Sound bounces off Red Rocks walls to perfection on this recording [18][19][25][26][27]
- **gd1982-07-28.167176.senn421.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 22 songs; 168 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1982-07-28.172642.senn421.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 171 min [4]

## Around the show

- Many people looked for tickets or tried to smuggle themselves in [16]
- Rain fell during all three nights, making tickets easier to obtain [18]
- Tapers experienced serious stressing at the start of the tape [19]
- Band played with Stephen for a minute before Not Fade Away [20]
- Half of Red Rocks' back half lit up at the tease [20]
- Garcia delivered a hot jam on Shakedown Street [22]
- Heads hung out at the Red Rocks amphitheatre before show time [22]
- Rain washed the audience pure for a few hours [23]
- This show has better balance among instruments than the following night [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-07-28.sbd.browning-feinberg.32707.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Cassettes provided by Joey Browning and Jake Feinberg; source: Soundboard of unknown lineage > ? > Cassette. [1]. Also: First five seconds of Shakedown patched from LMA audience source [1]
- **gd82-07-28.fob-senn421.wise.4980.sbefail.shnf**: taped by Jim Wise; transferred by Jim Wise; source: Audience Recording: Sennheiser 421's [2]. Also: Hosted by Mike Lai with checksums differing from previous shn set [2]
- **gd1982-07-28.167176.senn421.wiseman.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Scott Wiseman; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; AKG SE-5E mics with CE-1 cardioid capsules > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII 90) [3]. Also: Jim Wise provided Sennheiser 421 source for patches and crowd noise; Frank Streeter provided Nakamichi 700 source for Althea and crowd [3]
- **gd1982-07-28.172642.senn421.clugston.flac2496**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Master (FOB, near lip of stage)) Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony D5M (TDK-MA-C90) [4]. Also: Anonymous benefactors provided master cassette recording and transfer; Jim Wise and Charlie Miller provided Sennheiser 421 patches [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1982-07-28 Red Rocks Amphitheatre, Morrison, CO, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1982-07-28-red-rocks-amphitheatre-morrison-co-usa/) [29]
